scope: Read-only independent audit of final translation assembly, review bindings, actual source field extraction and MDX preservation. No import/promote or source-content mutation was performed.

corpus.verification: Exact byte equality with the originally reviewed corpus, not regenerated text.

checks.name: All units have exact independent source/target approval
Full dynamic page/shared-field scope and unique operation/binding keys
Actual source YAML equals corpus; source and target optimistic locks and actual owner identities match
Six array fields preserve ordered independently reviewed elements
Exact Name override: t_016 brand label Название; personal-name labels Имя; approved field fingerprint matches
All shared writes restricted to ru explanatory leaves, never original Prompt bodies, actual enum/default/user values, source URLs, model IDs, media or run parameters
All 381 original MDX ASTs equal corpus-reconstructed ASTs, including normalized source text
Target structure preserves headings, paragraphs, list items, strong text structure, blockquote, and exact ordered link destinations

observations: No code block, inline code, JSX, raw HTML, image node or MDX expression exists in the actual 381 source bodies; there is no such structure for the paragraph extraction to lose.

Four translated paragraphs begin directly with a source link where English begins with The. Removing the English article changes a plain-text node count but preserves paragraph/link structure and meaning; checked p_123, p_153, p_218 and t_017.

The parent added an explicit override targetHash === repository fingerprint({field: targetField, value: translation}) assertion to the assembler. The final batch byte hash is unchanged; regenerated bindings were reread and their exact approvals and override hash revalidated.

The reviewed 1666-unit corpus is now retained at production/localization/ru/evidence/translation-units.json with identical bytes. The assembler reads that durable path; the full batch byte hash remains unchanged.
limitations: This is a planned-batch audit, not proof that an import or promotion subsequently preserved the repository. Perform post-import source invariants and localization gates.
No browser, build, layout, performance, runtime or visual-media testing is claimed by this record.
The 427 UI messages are outside this 1793-shared-field batch and outside this integration audit. Their own review and release gates remain necessary.
Review evidence is AI/subagent source comparison, not human or native-speaker certification.

resolvedFindings: RU_ACCEPTANCE, RU_FULL_ACCEPTANCE or RU_PILOT_ACCEPTANCE independently requires a Russian artifact, preventing a missing locale from silently passing by skipping the suite.

Frozen scope must contain 381 pages and each source/scoped category must be nonempty. English must contain every scoped ID; Russian IDs must exactly equal scoped IDs, excluding unrelated unpublished English-preview drafts.
Every original literal and template-backed Prompt is reconstructed from validated source files, template version and original values; invalid or null template rendering fails.
Every actual served Prompt HTML body and language is compared to its source, and every popup JSON Prompt is fetched and checked against both detail data and source.
supportingInspection: PromptSheet renders the identified Prompt container with its original language.
AnnotatedText renders plain spans and phrase buttons without nested divs or extra textual markers; current HTML extraction preserves text and decodes entities after removing tags.
Nullable rendered text is explicitly rejected and regex captures use non-null assertions after the matching assertion.
limitations: No HTTP/E2E execution or passing build is claimed here. Static inspection was supplemented only by local generated-index scope comparisons; parent owns final build and E2E execution.

scopeCorrectionReview.conclusion: Scope-based comparison matches the frozen localization release boundary; all actual Russian page and original-Prompt assertions remain intact.
